column1: # Reviewed source order differences against the older Dreamcast roster.

column6: Mac retains the university adapter at code0+0x13ebfc before the spell helper at code0+0x1421e8, matching the Windows source and function sequence. Older Dreamcast line tables place ValueOfSpell at line 1945 before ValueOfUniversity at line 3708; preserve the later shared-source order supported by Mac and retail instead of moving either canonical helper.

DC CmbtMgr.h defines ValidHex at 1460 and MarkCreatureEffect at 1555, but the native field list (entries 146..159) declares MarkCreatureEffect beside spellEffect and the door members, where this in-class body stays. Moving the body out of class to the DC line order was measured: it is source-equivalent but shifts VC6 state in army.obj, lowering army::doAttack(army*, int) CUR from 99.9616 to 99.9232.
